description.sk: Šťavnatá zelenina, olivy a feta – bez varenia.
description.en: Juicy vegetables, olives and feta, no cooking required.

steps.sk: Paradajky umy, vykroj stopky a nakrájaj ich na mesiačiky alebo veľké kusy. Uhorku pásikovo ošúp a nakrájaj na hrubé polkolieska asi 1 cm – tenšie by pustili vodu a šalát by bol vodnatý.
steps.en: Wash the tomatoes, cut out the stems and cut them into wedges or large chunks. Peel the cucumber in stripes and cut it into thick half-moons about 1 cm – thinner slices release water and make the salad soggy.

steps.sk: Papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na prúžky, cibuľu na tenké krúžky. Ak je cibuľa ostrá, nechaj ju 5 minút v studenej vode a potom ju osuš.
steps.en: Seed the pepper and cut it into strips; slice the onion into thin rings. If the onion is sharp, soak it in cold water for 5 minutes and pat it dry.

steps.sk: Zeleninu daj do širokej misy, zľahka ju osoľ a pridaj olivy. Pokvapkaj 2 lyžicami oleja a opatrne premiešaj rukami – soľ vytiahne zo zeleniny šťavu, ktorá sa s olejom spojí do prirodzeného dresingu.
steps.en: Put the vegetables in a wide bowl, salt them lightly and add the olives. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the oil and toss gently with your hands – the salt draws juice from the vegetables, which mixes with the oil into a natural dressing.

steps.sk: Navrch polož fetu v jednom kuse (pri stole sa láme vidličkou). Oregano rozotri medzi prstami, aby zavoňalo, posyp ním fetu a pokvapkaj ju zvyšným olejom. Podávaj hneď, podľa chuti s chlebom na vytieranie šťavy.
steps.en: Lay the feta on top in one piece (it is broken up with a fork at the table). Rub the oregano between your fingers to release its aroma, sprinkle it over the feta and drizzle with the remaining oil. Serve at once, with bread to mop up the juices if you like.

title.sk: Kuracie souvlaki s tzatziki a ryžou
title.en: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki and rice

description.sk: Citrónovo-oreganové kura s chladivým tzatziki – výborné do krabičiek.
description.en: Lemon-oregano chicken with cooling tzatziki, great for lunch boxes.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia osuš a nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm – rovnako veľké sa upečú naraz. V mise ich premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja, 2 lyžicami citrónovej šťavy, 2 prelisovanými strúčikmi cesnaku, oreganom, paprikou, soľou a korením. Prikry a nechaj 15 minút marinovať (v chladničke pokojne aj do večera).
steps.en: Pat the chicken dry and cut it into roughly 3 cm cubes – pieces of the same size cook evenly. In a bowl mix them with 2 tablespoons of the oil, 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the oregano, paprika, salt and pepper. Cover and marinate for 15 minutes (or in the fridge until the evening).

steps.sk: Medzitým ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 400 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 400 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Tzatziki: uhorku nahrubo nastrúhaj, daj ju do sitka alebo čistej utierky a pevne z nej vytlač vodu – inak bude tzatziki riedke. Zmiešaj ju s jogurtom, zvyšným pretlačeným cesnakom, zvyšnou citrónovou šťavou a olejom a s nasekaným kôprom a daj do chladničky.
steps.en: Tzatziki: coarsely grate the cucumber, put it in a sieve or clean tea towel and squeeze out the water firmly – otherwise the tzatziki turns runny. Mix it with the yoghurt, the remaining crushed garlic, lemon juice and oil and the chopped dill and chill it.

steps.sk: Veľkú panvicu (najlepšie liatinovú alebo grilovaciu) rozpáľ na vysokom ohni. Mäso opekaj v dvoch dávkach – natlačené by pustilo šťavu a varilo sa. Prvé 2 minúty ho nechaj ležať, potom ho obracaj; spolu 8 až 10 minút na dávku.
steps.en: Heat a large frying pan (ideally cast iron or a griddle) over high heat. Cook the chicken in two batches – crowded, it releases its juices and stews. Leave it untouched for the first 2 minutes, then turn it; 8 to 10 minutes per batch in total.

steps.sk: Mäso je hotové, keď je zo všetkých strán zlaté a vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby (74 °C v strede najväčšej kocky). Hotovú dávku presuň na tanier a prikry alobalom, kým dopečieš druhú.
steps.en: The chicken is done when it is golden on all sides and white inside with no pink (74 °C in the centre of the largest cube). Move the finished batch to a plate and cover it with foil while you cook the second.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a tzatziki. Na meal prep rozdeľ ryžu s mäsom do 4 krabičiek a tzatziki daj zvlášť; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and tzatziki. For meal prep, divide the rice and chicken between 4 containers and pack the tzatziki separately; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Vajcia pošírované v korenistej paradajkovo-paprikovej omáčke.
description.en: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na prúžky a cesnak nasekaj. V panvici s pokrievkou (asi 26 cm) zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu s paprikou opekaj asi 6 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezačnú sa zlatiť.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, seed the pepper and cut it into strips, and chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a frying pan with a lid (about 26 cm) over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for about 6 minutes until soft and starting to colour.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, papriku a čili a za stáleho miešania opekaj asi minútu, kým korenie nezavonia. Nenechaj ho pripáliť – mletá paprika rýchlo zhorkne.
steps.en: Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli and stir for about a minute until the spices smell fragrant. Do not let them burn – ground paprika turns bitter quickly.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky, osoľ a var odokryté na strednom ohni 8 minút, občas premiešaj, kým omáčka nezhustne – stopa po vareške sa má chvíľu držať. V riedkej omáčke by sa vajcia rozliali.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, salt and simmer uncovered over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce thickens – a line drawn with the spoon should hold for a moment. In a thin sauce the eggs spread out.

steps.sk: Lyžicou urob v omáčke 4 jamky a do každej opatrne vylej vajce – najistejšie je rozbiť ho najprv do šálky. Bielky na okrajoch jemne premiešaj s omáčkou, žĺtky nechaj vcelku.
steps.en: Make 4 hollows in the sauce with a spoon and gently slide an egg into each – it is safest to crack each into a cup first. Lightly swirl the edges of the whites into the sauce, leaving the yolks whole.

steps.sk: Panvicu prikry a var na miernom ohni 5 až 7 minút, kým bielky nie sú úplne biele a stuhnuté, ale žĺtky ešte mäkké a pri pohnutí panvicou sa trasú. Ak chceš žĺtky natvrdo, var ešte 2 až 3 minúty.
steps.en: Cover the pan and cook over low heat for 5 to 7 minutes until the whites are completely white and set but the yolks are still soft and wobble when you move the pan. For firm yolks, cook for 2 to 3 minutes more.

steps.sk: Posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj priamo z panvice s chlebom na namáčanie.
steps.en: Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread for dipping.

description.sk: Krémový hummus z cíceru v konzerve za 10 minút.
description.en: Creamy hummus from canned chickpeas in 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cícer sceď cez sitko nad miskou a odlož si 4 lyžice nálevu – vďaka nemu bude hummus krémový. Cícer prepláchni studenou vodou. Ak chceš extra jemný hummus, pošúchaj ho medzi dlaňami a odober šupky, ktoré vyplávajú.
steps.en: Drain the chickpeas through a sieve over a bowl and keep 4 tablespoons of the liquid – it makes the hummus creamy. Rinse the chickpeas under cold water. For extra smooth hummus, rub them between your palms and pick off the skins that float up.

steps.sk: Do mixéra daj tahini, citrónovú šťavu, ošúpaný cesnak, rímsky kmín a soľ a mixuj asi minútu na hustú svetlú pastu. Ak sa tahini zrazí, prilej lyžicu nálevu a mixuj ďalej.
steps.en: Put the tahini, lemon juice, peeled garlic, cumin and salt in the blender and blend for about a minute into a thick pale paste. If the tahini seizes, add a spoonful of the chickpea liquid and keep blending.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a mixuj 2 až 3 minúty, pričom postupne prilievaš zvyšný nálev. Občas zastav mixér a zotri hmotu zo stien. Hummus je hotový, keď je úplne hladký a nadýchaný, bez zrniek.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and blend for 2 to 3 minutes, gradually adding the rest of the liquid. Stop now and then to scrape down the sides. The hummus is ready when it is completely smooth and fluffy with no grains left.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj a podľa potreby pridaj kvapku citróna. Rozotri hummus na tanier, lyžicou urob v strede priehlbinu, pokvapkaj olivovým olejom a posyp paprikou. Podávaj s pitou alebo so zeleninou. V uzavretej nádobe vydrží v chladničke 4 dni.
steps.en: Taste and add a drop more lemon if needed. Spread the hummus on a plate, make a well in the middle with a spoon, drizzle with the olive oil and dust with paprika. Serve with pitta or vegetables. In a closed container it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Hodvábne hladká a sýta polievka zo surovín za pár eur.
description.en: A silky smooth, filling soup made from ingredients that cost very little.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a mrkvu ošúp a nahrubo nastrúhaj. V hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a zeleninu opekaj asi 5 minút, kým cibuľa nezmäkne a nezosklovatie.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and peel and coarsely grate the carrot. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the vegetables for about 5 minutes until the onion is soft and translucent.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak, rímsky kmín a papriku a za stáleho miešania opekaj asi minútu, kým pretlak trochu nestmavne a korenie nezavonia – zbaví sa tak surovej kyslosti.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste, cumin and paprika and cook, stirring, for about a minute until the paste darkens a little and the spices smell fragrant – this takes away its raw sharpness.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra. Pridaj ju do hrnca s rozdrobeným bujónom a 1,2 l vody, priveď do varu a mierne var 20 minút, kým sa šošovica úplne nerozpadne. Občas premiešaj, aby sa nepripálila na dne.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils in a sieve until the water runs clear. Add them to the pan with the crumbled stock cube and 1.2 litres of water, bring to the boil and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the lentils have completely broken down. Stir now and then so they do not catch on the bottom.

steps.sk: Polievku rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu horúcej vody – šošovica ďalej hustne, kým polievka stojí.
steps.en: Blend the soup smooth with a stick blender. If it is too thick, add a little hot water – the lentils keep thickening as the soup stands.

steps.sk: Dochuť soľou a citrónovou šťavou – citrón polievku osvieži, preto ho nevynechávaj. Podávaj posypanú čili vločkami. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke.
steps.en: Season with the salt and lemon juice – the lemon brightens the soup, so do not skip it. Serve sprinkled with chilli flakes. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer.

title.sk: Kuskusový šalát s cícerom a bylinkami
title.en: Couscous salad with chickpeas and herbs

description.sk: Svieži šalát do krabičky, ktorý zasýti aj bez mäsa.
description.en: A fresh lunch-box salad that fills you up without meat.

steps.sk: Kuskus nasyp do misy, pridaj polovicu soli a lyžicu oleja a zalej ho 250 ml vriacej vody. Rýchlo premiešaj, prikry tanierom a nechaj 5 minút napučať.
steps.en: Put the couscous in a bowl, add half the salt and 1 tablespoon of the oil and pour over 250 ml of boiling water. Stir quickly, cover with a plate and leave to swell for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Kuskus rozpuč vidličkou, aby sa zrnká oddelili a nezostali v ňom hrudky, a nechaj ho odokrytý vychladnúť – na teplom kuskuse by zelenina zvädla.
steps.en: Fluff the couscous with a fork to separate the grains and break up any lumps, and let it cool uncovered – warm couscous wilts the vegetables.

steps.sk: Medzitým uhorku, paradajky a cibuľu nakrájaj na drobné kocky asi 5 mm. Z petržlenovej vňate odstráň hrubé stonky a lístky nasekaj nadrobno spolu s mätou. Cícer sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Meanwhile dice the cucumber, tomatoes and onion into small cubes about 5 mm. Remove the thick parsley stalks and finely chop the leaves together with the mint. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.sk: Dresing: v miske vyšľahaj zvyšný olej s citrónovou šťavou, rímskym kmínom a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Dressing: whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice, cumin and remaining salt in a small bowl.

steps.sk: K vychladnutému kuskusu pridaj zeleninu, cícer a bylinky, zalej dresingom a dôkladne premiešaj. Ochutnaj a podľa chuti pridaj citrón. Na meal prep ulož šalát do krabičiek; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni a na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Add the vegetables, chickpeas and herbs to the cooled couscous, pour over the dressing and mix thoroughly. Taste and add more lemon if you like. For meal prep, pack it into containers; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and tastes even better the next day.

title.sk: Mujadara – šošovica s ryžou a karamelizovanou cibuľou
title.en: Mujadara: lentils and rice with caramelised onions

description.sk: Lacná a voňavá klasika Blízkeho východu, úplne rastlinná.
description.en: A cheap, fragrant Middle Eastern classic, fully plant-based.

steps.sk: Cibule ošúp, rozpoľ a nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska. Vo veľkej panvici zohrej 3 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni, pridaj cibuľu a štipku zo soli a pomaly ju opekaj asi 20 minút; každé 2 až 3 minúty premiešaj. Najprv zmäkne, potom sa začne farbiť – cieľom je tmavozlatá, sladká cibuľa, nie spálená.
steps.en: Peel and halve the onions and slice them into thin half-moons. Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, add the onions and a pinch of the salt and cook them slowly for about 20 minutes, stirring every 2 to 3 minutes. They soften first, then colour – you want deep golden, sweet onions, not burnt ones.

steps.sk: Medzitým šošovicu prepláchni a v hrnci ju zalej 800 ml vody. Priveď do varu a mierne var 15 minút, kým nie je napoly mäkká – zvonku mäkne, v strede ešte pruží. Vodu nevylievaj, ryža sa v nej uvarí.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the lentils and put them in a pan with 800 ml of water. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 15 minutes until half cooked – soft outside, still firm in the middle. Do not drain them; the rice cooks in this water.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra. K šošovici pridaj ryžu, rímsky kmín, škoricu, zvyšnú soľ a polovicu cibule. Premiešaj, priveď do varu, prikry a na najmenšom ohni var 18 minút, kým ryža nevsiakne všetku vodu. Ak by voda vsiakla skôr, ako ryža zmäkne, prilej 50 ml.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear. Add it to the lentils with the cumin, cinnamon, remaining salt and half the onions. Stir, bring to the boil, cover and cook over the lowest heat for 18 minutes until the rice has absorbed all the water. If the water is gone before the rice is tender, add 50 ml.

steps.sk: Zvyšnú cibuľu v panvici opeč so zvyšným olejom na vyššom ohni ešte 2 až 3 minúty, kým okraje nezačnú chrumkať – navrchu bude kontrastovať s mäkkou ryžou.
steps.en: Fry the remaining onions in the pan with the rest of the oil over higher heat for another 2 to 3 minutes until the edges crisp – on top they contrast with the soft rice.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav a nechaj mujadaru 5 minút odpočinúť pod pokrievkou, potom ju vidličkou prevzdušni a okoreň.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and let the mujadara rest, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork and season with the pepper.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypanú chrumkavou cibuľou a nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou, napríklad s jogurtom alebo šalátom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni; cibuľu na meal prep skladuj zvlášť, aby zostala chrumkavá.
steps.en: Serve topped with the crisp onions and chopped parsley, for example with yoghurt or a salad. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days; for meal prep store the onions separately so they stay crisp.

description.sk: Falafel z rúry, chrumkavý bez fritovania, s citrónovou tahini omáčkou.
description.en: Oven-baked falafel, crisp without frying, with lemony tahini sauce.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C (horný a spodný ohrev) a plech vylož papierom na pečenie. Cícer sceď, prepláchni a veľmi dôkladne osuš papierovými utierkami – mokrý cícer by sa pri pečení rozpadal. Cibuľu nakrájaj na štvrtiny, cesnak ošúp a z petržlenu odrež hrubé stonky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (conventional) and line a baking tray with baking paper. Drain and rinse the chickpeas and dry them very thoroughly with kitchen paper – wet chickpeas fall apart in the oven. Quarter the onion, peel the garlic and cut the thick stalks off the parsley.

steps.sk: Cícer, cibuľu, cesnak, petržlen, rímsky kmín a koriander daj do sekáčika a pulzne mixuj, kým zmes nepripomína hrubý piesok s viditeľnými zelenými kúskami. Nemixuj na pyré – falafel by bol mazľavý a hutný.
steps.en: Put the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and coriander in the food processor and pulse until the mixture looks like coarse sand with visible green flecks. Do not blend it to a purée – the falafel would turn pasty and dense.

steps.sk: Hmotu prelož do misy a primiešaj múku, prášok do pečiva, soľ (štipku si odlož do omáčky) a lyžicu oleja. Ak sa po stlačení v dlani nedrží pokope, pridaj ešte lyžicu múky. Navlhčenými rukami vytvaruj 16 placiek hrubých asi 1,5 cm a poukladaj ich na plech.
steps.en: Tip the mixture into a bowl and mix in the flour, baking powder, salt (keep a pinch for the sauce) and 1 tablespoon of the oil. If it does not hold together when squeezed in your palm, add another spoonful of flour. With wet hands shape 16 patties about 1.5 cm thick and put them on the tray.

steps.sk: Placky potri zvyšným olejom a peč 13 minút, potom ich opatrne obráť.
steps.en: Brush the patties with the remaining oil and bake for 13 minutes, then turn them carefully.

steps.sk: Peč ďalších 12 minút, kým nie sú z oboch strán zlatohnedé a na povrchu chrumkavé. Medzitým priprav omáčku: tahini rozmiešaj s citrónovou šťavou a štipkou soli, postupne prilievaj 4 až 5 lyžíc studenej vody a miešaj, kým nie je krémová a hladká.
steps.en: Bake for another 12 minutes until golden brown on both sides and crisp on the surface. Meanwhile make the sauce: stir the tahini with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, then gradually add 4 to 5 tablespoons of cold water, stirring, until creamy and smooth.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplý falafel s omáčkou, v pite alebo so šalátom. Upečený vydrží v chladničke 4 dni; zohrej ho 8 minút v rúre pri 180 °C, aby bol znova chrumkavý.
steps.en: Serve the falafel warm with the sauce, in pitta or with a salad. Baked falafel keeps in the fridge for 4 days; reheat it in the oven at 180 °C for 8 minutes to crisp it up again.

title.sk: Marocký tagine s cícerom a batátmi
title.en: Moroccan chickpea and sweet potato tagine

description.sk: Sladkokorenistý rastlinný guláš so škoricou a kuskusom.
description.en: A sweet-spiced plant-based stew with cinnamon, served with couscous.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj. Batát ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm, datle zbav kôstok a nasekaj. Cícer sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into roughly 2 cm cubes; stone and chop the dates. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty, kým nezmäkne. Pridaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, škoricu, kurkumu a zázvor a miešaj ešte minútu, kým korenie nezavonia – opražené korenie má plnšiu chuť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric and ginger and stir for another minute until fragrant – toasted spices taste fuller.

steps.sk: Pridaj batát, paradajky, datle, rozdrobený bujón a 300 ml vody, premiešaj a priveď do varu. Prikry, zníž oheň a mierne var 20 minút; občas premiešaj, aby sa nič neprichytilo na dne.
steps.en: Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, dates, crumbled stock cube and 300 ml of water, stir and bring to the boil. Cover, lower the heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally so nothing sticks.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a var odokryté ďalších 5 minút, kým batát nie je mäkký a omáčka nezhustne. Datle sa rozvaria a omáčku jemne osladia. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce thickens. The dates melt into it and sweeten it gently. If it gets too thick, add a little water.

steps.sk: Medzitým kuskus nasyp do misy, zalej 250 ml vriacej vody, prikry tanierom a nechaj 5 minút napučať. Potom ho vidličkou rozpuč, aby bol sypký.
steps.en: Meanwhile put the couscous in a bowl, pour over 250 ml of boiling water, cover with a plate and leave to swell for 5 minutes. Then fluff it with a fork.

steps.sk: Podávaj tagine na kuskuse posypané nasekaným koriandrom. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke (bez kuskusu); na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Serve the tagine on the couscous, sprinkled with chopped coriander. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer (without the couscous) and tastes even better the next day.

description.sk: Vrstvy baklažánu, korenistého mäsa a bešamelu, zapečené dozlatista.
description.en: Layers of eggplant, spiced meat and béchamel, baked until golden.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C (horný a spodný ohrev) a dva plechy vylož papierom. Baklažány umy, odrež stopky a pozdĺžne ich nakrájaj na plátky hrubé 1 cm. Poukladaj ich v jednej vrstve, potri 3 lyžicami oleja, osoľ tretinou soli a peč 20 minút, kým nie sú mäkké a zlatisté – upečený baklažán nenasaje toľko tuku a musaka nebude vodnatá.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (conventional) and line two baking trays. Wash the aubergines, cut off the stems and slice them lengthways 1 cm thick. Lay them in a single layer, brush with 3 tablespoons of the oil, season with a third of the salt and bake for 20 minutes until soft and golden – baked aubergine soaks up less fat and keeps the moussaka from turning watery.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj. V širokej panvici zohrej zvyšný olej a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút domäkka, pridaj cesnak a po pol minúte mäso. Varechou ho rozbíjaj a na vyššom ohni opekaj asi 6 minút, kým nie je hnedé a bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the onion and the garlic. Heat the remaining oil in a wide frying pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and after half a minute the beef. Break it up with a wooden spoon and brown it over higher heat for about 6 minutes until no pink remains.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, škoricu, oregano a ďalšiu tretinu soli, premiešaj a nechaj 20 minút odokryté dusiť na miernom ohni, kým sa tekutina z väčšej časti neodparí a omáčka nie je hustá – riedka by z musaky vytekala.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano and another third of the salt, stir and simmer uncovered over low heat for 20 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated and the sauce is thick – a thin sauce would run out of the moussaka.

steps.sk: Bešamel: v hrnci roztop maslo, vmiešaj múku a za stáleho miešania ju 1 až 2 minúty praž, kým nezačne voňať ako sušienky, ale nezhnedne. Po troškách prilievaj mlieko a metličkou miešaj, aby nevznikli hrudky. Var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne ako puding.
steps.en: Béchamel: melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes until it smells like biscuits but does not brown. Add the milk a little at a time, whisking to prevent lumps. Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce is as thick as custard.

steps.sk: Bešamel stiahni z ohňa, nechaj ho 2 minúty trochu vychladnúť a potom rýchlo vmiešaj vajce (v horúcom by sa zrazilo), polovicu nastrúhaného parmezánu, muškátový oriešok a zvyšnú soľ.
steps.en: Take the béchamel off the heat, let it cool for 2 minutes and then quickly whisk in the egg (it would scramble in very hot sauce), half the grated parmesan, the nutmeg and the remaining salt.

steps.sk: Rúru stiahni na 180 °C. Do zapekacej misy (asi 30 × 20 cm) poukladaj polovicu baklažánu, naň rozotri mäsovú zmes, prikry ju zvyšným baklažánom a navrch rovnomerne rozotri bešamel. Posyp zvyšným parmezánom.
steps.en: Turn the oven down to 180 °C. Lay half the aubergine in a baking dish (about 30 × 20 cm), spread the meat sauce over it, cover with the rest of the aubergine and spread the béchamel evenly on top. Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan.

steps.sk: Peč 40 minút, kým nie je povrch zlatohnedý a na okrajoch bublá.
steps.en: Bake for 40 minutes until the top is golden brown and bubbling at the edges.

steps.sk: Pred krájaním nechaj musaku aspoň 15 minút odpočinúť – vrstvy sa spevnia a pri krájaní sa nerozpadnú. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a dá sa zamraziť po porciách.
steps.en: Let the moussaka rest for at least 15 minutes before cutting – the layers firm up and hold together when sliced. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and freezes well in portions.

description.sk: Hustá rastlinná polievka s olivovým olejom a zeleninou.
description.en: A thick plant-based soup with olive oil and vegetables.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, mrkvu ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska a zeler na plátky asi 5 mm. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni studenou vodou.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, peel and slice the carrots into rounds and cut the celery into slices about 5 mm. Drain the beans and rinse them under cold water.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a zeleninu opekaj asi 8 minút, občas premiešaj, kým nezmäkne a cibuľa nezosklovatie. Neponáhľaj sa – pomaly opečená zelenina je základ chuti.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the vegetables for about 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and the onion is translucent. Do not rush – slowly cooked vegetables are the base of the flavour.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak a minútu ho opekaj so zeleninou. Pridaj paradajky, fazuľu, bobkový list, oregano, soľ a 1 l vody, priveď do varu, čiastočne prikry a mierne var 25 minút, kým mrkva nie je mäkká.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste and cook it with the vegetables for a minute. Add the tomatoes, beans, bay leaf, oregano, salt and 1 litre of water, bring to the boil, partly cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes until the carrots are tender.

steps.sk: Bobkový list vyber. Asi tretinu fazule roztlač varechou o stenu hrnca alebo polievku krátko premixuj ponorným mixérom – zhustne a bude krémovejšia, no stále s celými fazuľami.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf. Crush about a third of the beans against the side of the pan with a spoon or give the soup a few pulses with a stick blender – it thickens and turns creamier while keeping whole beans.

steps.sk: Okoreň, ochutnaj a podávaj v miskách pokvapkanú zvyšným olivovým olejom, podľa chuti s chlebom. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke.
steps.en: Season with the pepper, taste and serve in bowls drizzled with the remaining olive oil, with bread if you like. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer.

title.sk: Gemista – zelenina plnená ryžou a bylinkami
title.en: Gemista: vegetables stuffed with herbed rice

description.sk: Grécke papriky a paradajky plnené ryžou s mätou a petržlenom, pečené v rúre.
description.en: Greek peppers and tomatoes stuffed with mint and parsley rice, baked in the oven.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Papriky aj paradajky umy a odrež z nich vrchnáky asi 1 cm pod stopkou – odlož si ich, poslúžia ako pokrievky. Z paprík vyber semienka a biele blany.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (conventional). Wash the peppers and tomatoes and cut off their tops about 1 cm below the stem – keep them as lids. Remove the seeds and white membranes from the peppers.

steps.sk: Paradajky lyžičkou opatrne vydlabaj tak, aby stena zostala celá, a vnútro aj so šťavou nadrobno nasekaj. Vydlabanú zeleninu zvnútra zľahka osoľ štipkou zo soli a postav ju do zapekacej misy.
steps.en: Carefully scoop out the tomatoes with a teaspoon, keeping the walls intact, and finely chop the insides together with their juice. Lightly salt the inside of the hollowed vegetables with a pinch of the salt and stand them in a baking dish.

steps.sk: Plnka: v mise zmiešaj surovú prepláchnutú ryžu, nasekanú paradajkovú dužinu so šťavou, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, prelisovaný cesnak, nasekaný petržlen a mätu, 3 lyžice oleja, zvyšnú soľ a korenie. Nechaj 10 minút postáť, aby ryža nasala šťavu.
steps.en: Filling: in a bowl mix the rinsed raw rice, the chopped tomato flesh with its juice, the finely chopped onion, crushed garlic, chopped parsley and mint, 3 tablespoons of the oil, the remaining salt and the pepper. Leave for 10 minutes so the rice soaks up the juice.

steps.sk: Zeleninu naplň plnkou len do troch štvrtín – ryža pri pečení napučí a vytiekla by. Do každej prilej lyžicu šťavy z misy a prikry vrchnákmi. Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na mesiačiky a poukladaj ich do medzier medzi zeleninou.
steps.en: Fill the vegetables only three-quarters full – the rice swells as it bakes and would spill over. Spoon a little juice from the bowl into each and put the lids on. Peel the potatoes, cut them into wedges and tuck them into the gaps between the vegetables.

steps.sk: Passatu rozmiešaj s 200 ml vody a zalej ňou zemiaky v mise, nie plnenú zeleninu. Všetko pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom, misu pevne prikry alobalom alebo pokrievkou a peč 40 minút.
steps.en: Mix the passata with 200 ml of water and pour it over the potatoes in the dish, not over the stuffed vegetables. Drizzle everything with the remaining oil, cover the dish tightly with foil or a lid and bake for 40 minutes.

steps.sk: Misu odkry a peč ďalších 30 minút, kým vrchy zeleniny nie sú zhnednuté a ryža po ochutnaní mäkká. Ak by sa omáčka odparila, prilej trochu horúcej vody.
steps.en: Uncover the dish and bake for another 30 minutes until the tops of the vegetables are browned and the rice is tender when tasted. If the sauce dries out, add a little hot water.

steps.sk: Pred podávaním nechaj gemistu 10 minút odpočinúť, aby sa šťava usadila. Najlepšie chutí teplá, nie horúca; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni a ohriata je ešte lepšia.
steps.en: Let the gemista rest for 10 minutes before serving so the juices settle. It is best warm rather than piping hot; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is even better reheated.

description.sk: Korenisté kuracie stehná s cesnakovým jogurtom, ryžou a šalátom.
description.en: Spiced chicken thighs with garlic yogurt, rice and salad.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná osuš a nakrájaj na prúžky asi 1,5 cm. V mise ich premiešaj s olejom, 2 lyžicami citrónovej šťavy, rímskym kmínom, paprikou, koriandrom, kurkumou, škoricou, 1 lyžičkou soli a 2 lyžicami jogurtu. Prikry a nechaj 15 minút marinovať – v chladničke aj do druhého dňa.
steps.en: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut them into strips about 1.5 cm wide. In a bowl mix them with the oil, 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice, the cumin, paprika, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, 1 teaspoon of the salt and 2 tablespoons of the yoghurt. Cover and marinate for 15 minutes – or in the fridge until the next day.

steps.sk: Medzitým ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a zalej ju 400 ml vody so štipkou zo zvyšnej soli. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 400 ml of water and a pinch of the remaining salt. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cesnakový jogurt: zvyšný jogurt zmiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom, zvyšnou citrónovou šťavou a zvyšnou soľou. Uhorku a paradajky nakrájaj na kocky a cibuľu na tenké polkolieska.
steps.en: Garlic yoghurt: mix the remaining yoghurt with the crushed garlic, the rest of the lemon juice and the rest of the salt. Dice the cucumber and tomatoes and slice the onion into thin half-moons.

steps.sk: Veľkú panvicu rozpáľ na vysokom ohni (olej netreba, je v marináde) a mäso rozlož v jednej vrstve, v prípade potreby vo dvoch dávkach. Prvé 3 minúty ním nehýb, potom ho obracaj; spolu ho opekaj 8 až 10 minút.
steps.en: Heat a large frying pan over high heat (no extra oil needed, it is in the marinade) and spread the chicken in a single layer, in two batches if necessary. Leave it untouched for the first 3 minutes, then turn it; cook for 8 to 10 minutes in total.

steps.sk: Mäso je hotové, keď sú okraje tmavé a chrumkavé a vnútri dosiahne 75 °C – po prekrojení je bez ružovej farby. Jogurt v marináde sa pripaľuje rýchlo, preto ak dno tmavne príliš, zníž oheň na stredný.
steps.en: The chicken is done when the edges are dark and crisp and it reaches 75 °C inside – no pink when cut. The yoghurt in the marinade catches quickly, so if the pan darkens too much, lower the heat to medium.

steps.sk: Do misiek rozdeľ ryžu, navrch mäso a zeleninu a pridaj lyžicu cesnakového jogurtu. Na meal prep ulož jedlo do 4 krabičiek a jogurt so zeleninou daj zvlášť; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Divide the rice between bowls, top with the chicken and vegetables and add a spoonful of the garlic yoghurt. For meal prep, pack into 4 containers with the yoghurt and vegetables on the side; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Libanonský šalát, v ktorom hlavnú úlohu hrá petržlen.
description.en: A Lebanese salad where parsley is the star.

steps.sk: Bulgur daj do misy, zalej 200 ml vriacej vody, prikry tanierom a nechaj 15 minút napučať. Potom ho rozpuč vidličkou a nechaj odokrytý vychladnúť; ak na dne zostala voda, sceď ho v sitku.
steps.en: Put the bulgur in a bowl, pour over 200 ml of boiling water, cover with a plate and leave to swell for 15 minutes. Then fluff it with a fork and let it cool uncovered; if water is left at the bottom, drain it in a sieve.

steps.sk: Medzitým petržlen umy a veľmi dôkladne osuš – mokré bylinky sa zle krájajú a šalát by bol vodnatý. Odrež hrubé stonky a lístky ostrým nožom nadrobno nasekaj spolu s mätou. V pravom tabouleh je viac petržlenu ako bulguru.
steps.en: Meanwhile wash the parsley and dry it very thoroughly – wet herbs are hard to chop and make the salad watery. Cut off the thick stalks and finely chop the leaves together with the mint using a sharp knife. Real tabbouleh has more parsley than bulgur.

steps.sk: Paradajky rozpoľ, lyžičkou vyber semená so šťavou a dužinu nakrájaj na kocky asi 5 mm. Rovnako nakrájaj uhorku a jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na tenké kolieska.
steps.en: Halve the tomatoes, scoop out the seeds and juice with a teaspoon and dice the flesh into cubes of about 5 mm. Dice the cucumber the same way and slice the spring onions thinly.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj bylinky, zeleninu a vychladnutý bulgur. Zalej citrónovou šťavou a olejom, osoľ a dôkladne premiešaj. Ochutnaj – tabouleh má byť výrazne citrónový.
steps.en: Combine the herbs, vegetables and cooled bulgur in a bowl. Pour over the lemon juice and oil, season with the salt and mix thoroughly. Taste – tabbouleh should be distinctly lemony.

steps.sk: Nechaj ho 10 minút postáť, aby sa chute spojili, a podávaj. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni; bylinky časom stmavnú, ale chuť zostane dobrá.
steps.en: Leave it for 10 minutes for the flavours to come together, then serve. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days; the herbs darken over time but it still tastes good.

description.sk: Krémový dip z pečeného baklažánu s tahini a citrónom.
description.en: A creamy dip of roasted eggplant with tahini and lemon.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Baklažány umy, na viacerých miestach ich prepichni vidličkou – inak by v rúre mohli prasknúť – a polož ich celé na plech vystlaný papierom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (conventional). Wash the aubergines, prick them in several places with a fork – otherwise they can burst in the oven – and lay them whole on a lined baking tray.

steps.sk: Peč 40 minút, v polovici ich otoč. Sú hotové, keď sú úplne splasnuté, šupka je zvráskavená a miestami čierna a po stlačení sú mäkké až do stredu. Čím tmavšia šupka, tým výraznejšia dymová chuť.
steps.en: Roast for 40 minutes, turning them halfway. They are done when completely collapsed, the skin is wrinkled and blackened in places and they feel soft right to the centre when pressed. The darker the skin, the smokier the flavour.

steps.sk: Baklažány nechaj vychladnúť, kým ich udržíš v ruke, potom ich pozdĺžne rozkroj a lyžicou vyber dužinu. Prelož ju do sitka a nechaj 5 minút odkvapkať – horkastá šťava by dip zriedila.
steps.en: Let the aubergines cool until you can handle them, then split them lengthways and scoop out the flesh with a spoon. Put it in a sieve and let it drain for 5 minutes – the bitter juice would make the dip runny.

steps.sk: Dužinu nahrubo nasekaj nožom alebo roztlač vidličkou – mixér by z nej urobil kašu, dip má mať štruktúru. V mise ju vymiešaj s tahini, citrónovou šťavou, pretlačeným cesnakom, rímskym kmínom a soľou.
steps.en: Roughly chop the flesh with a knife or mash it with a fork – a blender turns it to mush, and the dip should have some texture. In a bowl mix it with the tahini, lemon juice, crushed garlic, cumin and salt.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj a dochuť citrónom. Rozotri na tanier, pokvapkaj olivovým olejom a podávaj s pitou alebo so zeleninou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Taste and add more lemon if needed. Spread on a plate, drizzle with the olive oil and serve with pitta or vegetables. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.en: Harira: Moroccan lentil and chickpea soup

description.sk: Korenistá polievka so zázvorom, škoricou a bylinkami.
description.en: A spiced soup with ginger, cinnamon and herbs.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a zeler na tenké plátky. Šošovicu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a cícer sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and thinly slice the celery. Rinse the lentils in a sieve until the water runs clear, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu so zelerom opekaj 5 minút, kým nezmäknú. Pridaj zázvor, kurkumu, škoricu a pretlak a za stáleho miešania opekaj minútu, kým korenie nezavonia a pretlak nestmavne.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion and celery for 5 minutes until soft. Add the ginger, turmeric, cinnamon and tomato paste and cook, stirring, for a minute until fragrant and the paste darkens.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, šošovicu, rozdrobené bujóny a 1,5 l vody, priveď do varu a mierne var 25 minút, kým sa šošovica nerozpadne a polievku nezahustí. Občas premiešaj, šošovica sa rada prichytí na dno.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, lentils, crumbled stock cubes and 1.5 litres of water, bring to the boil and simmer gently for 25 minutes until the lentils break down and thicken the soup. Stir occasionally – lentils like to stick to the bottom.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a polovicu nasekaných byliniek a var ešte 10 minút. Ak je polievka príliš hustá, prilej trochu horúcej vody.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and half the chopped herbs and simmer for 10 minutes more. If the soup is too thick, add a little hot water.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav a dochuť citrónovou šťavou – harira má byť jemne kyslá. Podávaj posypanú zvyšnými bylinkami, podľa chuti s chlebom. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke; pri ohrievaní ju zrieď trochou vody, lebo zhustne.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and season with the lemon juice – harira should be gently sour. Serve sprinkled with the remaining herbs, with bread if you like. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer; thin it with a little water when reheating, as it thickens.
